headline: President Bush creates a council of outside experts to advise him on science and technology.
what_it_does: This order sets up the President's Council of Advisors on Science and Technology, a group that gives the President advice on science and technology issues. Based on the title alone, few other details can be confirmed, such as who serves on the council or exactly what it reviews.

who_it_affects.group: Scientists and technology experts outside government
who_it_affects.how: Some may be chosen to serve on the council and give advice to the President.
They gain a formal advisory group to consult on science and technology policy.
